title: Maji de Fuwawa ni Okane Watasanai!!

lines.en: I do like to sleep in the bed...
lines.ja: フワワのベッドのお供はね…

lines.en: ...with foods. Okay?
lines.ja: お供？食べ物だよ

lines.en: With foods! Umu!
lines.ja: 食べ物だよ！

lines.en: And you know...
lines.ja: だから…

lines.en: I have my banana, right? That I sleep in the bed with my banana pillow right? Umu!
lines.ja: ベッドにバナナあるでしょ？フワワはバナナ型の枕で寝てるよね

lines.en: But recently, as in... A while ago.
lines.ja: でも最近は…ちょっと前に、ね

lines.en: Yeah, and you know we were out having some fun with Biboo! Yeah!
lines.ja: この前ビブーと3人で遊びに出かけて

lines.en: And, you know, there was an arcade, so we were like, "Let's go!" "What's there?" Yeah! Arcade!
lines.ja: ゲーセンを見つけたんだ！「いくぞ～！」「何があるかな！」ゲーセン～！

lines.en: And they have like one machine where, you know, there's like a plushie, a big plushie! A big big big plushie!
lines.ja: そしたらクレーンゲームの景品に大きなぬいぐるみが！めちゃくちゃデカいやつ！

lines.en: And it's stuck to a string and then you have to cut that string!
lines.ja: 糸を切って景品を落とすタイプでね

lines.en: Well, there was a tuna on that line, and I was like, "Okay, I'm just gonna do it. Watch me."
lines.ja: その中にマグロのぬいぐるみがあったから…「お姉ちゃんが取ってあげる！」

notes.meaning: クレーンゲームのマグロのぬいぐるみを、釣りに例えて言っている

lines.en: In the mood for fishing!
lines.ja: 釣り人みたいに！

lines.en: THREE tries, Ruffians! I got it in three tries!
lines.ja: 3回だよ！3回で取れちゃった！

lines.en: She's lying. Yeah. She did not... No! I don't...
lines.ja: ウソつき 3回じゃないよ

lines.en: It did not take three tries! I... It was three tries!
lines.ja: 3回じゃないでしょ！さっ…3回で取れたよ！

lines.en: No, you had to be like, "Mococo, give me money!"
lines.ja: フワワ言ってたじゃん「モゴぢゃんお金！お金貸して！」

lines.en: It was five tries, then. "Mococo, give me money!" It was five—
lines.ja: いや5回！5回で取れた！「ﾓｺﾞﾁﾞｬﾝｵｶﾈ…」

lines.en: "Mococo give me—" You just remember the money part, Mogojyan!
lines.ja: お金のくだりだけ覚えてるでしょモコちゃん！

notes.meaning: モコちゃんの呼び方のひとつ（愛称）

lines.en: No! No! It was definitely over 1,000 yen! It was at least five maybe. No!
lines.ja: いや絶対1000円以上使ってた！たぶん5回！ウソだ！

lines.en: It was not over 1,000 yen! No!
lines.ja: 1000円以内だもん！ウソだ！

lines.en: You made me give you 500 yen! And that was multiple times! No, that was a different time, Mogojyan!
lines.ja: モココに500円払わせた！しかも何度も！それは別のやつでしょモコちゃん！

lines.en: That was a different time!
lines.ja: それは別のやつ！

lines.en: Ask Biboo for the facts.
lines.ja: ビブーに聞いて確かめようね

lines.en: Go fact check. Okay, Ruffians? Fact check with Biboo. Okay!
lines.ja: ファクトチェックだよラフィアンズ！3回で取れたか聞こう

notes.meaning: 事実確認する、裏取りをする

lines.en: I did it in three, maybe five times, okay?
lines.ja: 5回かもしれないけどね

lines.en: Whae?
lines.ja: わぇ
